text_block_list.text:
Katsuragi Ace steadily built up her 
strength heading into the Satsuki Sho. 
However, the world's hopes and 
expectations were pinned entirely on Mr. 
C.B.—

All the talk was of Shiina Frejus, who had 
ties to a prestigious pedigree. Katsuragi 
Ace's name wasn't mentioned at all. 
However, Shiina Frejus herself thought 
differently.

She took note of Katsuragi Ace's rapid 
rise. On top of that, she declared she 
would defeat Mr. C.B. right along with 
her.

Even against prestigious pedigrees, she 
will conquer the Satsuki Sho. Katsuragi 
Ace fired herself up even more!
